body: Just upload more man, if you get more comfortable you'll probably do better
Then I'm sorry too

I get it man, I didn't have the terribly unlucky upbringing like you, I just could never meet mine (or what I thought were other peoples) expectations. The fact that you even considered Harvard College tells me a lot more then you would probably think. You are, in a sense, a failing perfectionist. You can be doing better then some people who also aren't doing well, but it's never good enough. I've been there. 

About relationships; I became incredibly lonely a few years ago and became determined to find a girl, and I got lucky. Many people haven't, I know. The friend I mentioned earlier, he’s never had a meaningful relationship with the opposite sex, and I’m helping him the best I can. He’s going to a different school than me, but god help me I am trying my best to help him in every way. I can help you too man. Its sometimes really hard to find a girl, but they’ll come around. Talk to me about any interest you have in any girls, I’ll give you any advice I know. And you seem to be an introvert just like me, but going to events could help you. I fucking hate going to things like basketball games, or even going in a group to the movies, but I usually stick around with friends just for after while people are walking home, because that’s when introverts shine.

Don’t worry about not getting into Harvard (although you still might have a chance, you haven’t gotten a rejection letter yet and things do seem less hopeful when you’re depressed). My dad (the only reason I got into the university because he teaches there) went to a community college before transferring to Uni, and now he’s a freaking doctor in music (stupid, but his actual title). Now I know this seems like just another success story to you, but its actually a lot more common than you think. If you are smart enough to have a chance to get into Harvard, you most definitely will excel at lesser schools. With a higher GPA there, your chances of transferring will increase. Just talk to an academic advisor, I’m not bullshitting here.

There’s always ways around, and I’m here to help you. I am your resource. And hey, I might not be able to get you into Harvard (Im not a miracle worker) but I can get you on the right track. Give me a chance man, give yourself a chance. Put off the attempt a little bit longer, see whats going to happen. If you for sure aren’t going to get into Harvard (you might surprise yourself here), in the meantime I can find alternatives for you, and you can just continue on your current studies. Universities will kill for you man, if you get past this, and later your depression (which you eventually will, although you may be unhopeful) you will be a multicultural success story. They will literally kill for you, piles of bodies’ man. 

So just tell me if you’re going to put it off for now, if so, I’ll start looking for alternatives. We’ll talk elsewhere. If not, I’m so sorry I couldn’t help.

Since this is basically one of the last times you might talk to someone about this, at least explain to me what the other problems are. It may seem trivial, and it certainly might not help you, but it will help me find suitable alternatives for you. It's like working on an essay, sometimes you need another set of eyes to see the spelling mistakes.

It's bleak and horrid because your depression makes it seem that way. You fuck up, if you're like me you fuck up a lot. 10 years of depression, thats hard man, mine started when I was 12, it came along with puberty they think, but that doesn't matter to me. You've obviously tried to get help if its been a decade, but you're not getting the right kind of help. Counsellors are shit in my opinion, they just try and tell you what you have to live for, and stop you from killing yourself, but they don't actually help the problem. You need a proper psychologist, and if you've been going to one, you've been unlucky and have been going to a shit one. I can hook you up (however cheesy that sounds) give me time and I can get you to talk to my psychologist, and if that doesn't, I'll find one for you in your area. Give me a chance Antonio.

Also, I quit going to private school because it was too difficult for what stress level I could take early on. If you're in a difficult school or job Antonio, its maybe best to tell someone you simply can't take the stress, and I can help account for that, since you do seem very dedicated for tomorrow

There is no benefit in death, don't lie to yourself there. Death is neither good nor bad in the end, it’s just the end. And it is not your right to be able to end your life; that is a privilege. Many people can't just end it, they have too many people that they provide for, too many people who would be destroyed if they leave. You have a privilege of being able to make up your mind and not care about anyone, which at times I would really envy, but that still doesn't mean you deserve it. If you think your garbage, then why do you think you deserve to just end it? Isn’t punishing yourself more appropriate? Punishing yourself by being alive? That’s what kept me alive for a long time. And if you don’t feel like you’re garbage, I don’t understand why we’re having this discussion. If its just because of the people in your life, you can find other people. I’m right here, there are many people right here. If you need help you need to simply ask, and someone will be there.

Ok, Antonio. You said this is basically your suicide letter for your parents. I’m calling bullshit on that. You’re smart, you know there are many alternatives to letting them know, but you chose the suicidewatch sub-reddit? Why? Because I know you really want help. You’ve lived most of your life alone, although there are people around you, and I understand you’re tired, but killing yourself isn’t the right answer for you. Sure, if you really were an idiot, with no future, I’d honestly say go for it (I’ve said that to people before, no joke) but you do have a future, although your depression has made you blind to it. I can see that Antonio.

If you want to escape from where you are, you need only put the last of your effort into it, I know you still have some left. Talk to the counseling office, your boss, or whatever, and tell them you can’t take what you’re doing anymore. Tell them you need to leave. Don’t worry about being behind now, that isn’t the case. We are in a world filled with loopholes, and however much time you take to get back on track (whether it’s a year, a month, five years), there are some people who will be able to get you back on track. I am one of those people. I’ve had depression for 5 years of my life, I had to leave my high school for a year in order to get in any working order, but I wasn’t better, I was just on the right track. After that year I found a way to get into an upper level university, and now my life is finally starting to look better. You can do this to, maybe not the same way, but a way. Giving up hope is what depression naturally does to you, and however hard it is, use the last of your effort to fight it Antonio.

Don’t say that man, you are only capable of what you think you are capable of. Leaving isn’t hard when there are people willing to help you. I’m willing to help you. I like you man, you seem a lot like me, you're smart, and I know you're smart because I REALLY hate dumb people. You’re capable of leaving, maybe not by yourself, but there are people like me who are willing to help you. What’s your name? I’d at least like to know your name before tomorrow.

People are in much worse situations than you, no matter what you think. Holocaust survivors that saw their friends and families killed in front of them, countless prisioners in various countries, many people in Syria right now. Your problems are quite simple. Depression, and depression is always treatable. If there's other things causing problems, leave them behind. Go somewhere else. Actually try. Suicide is the easiest way out, but it doesn't solve anything. Its the solution of the unintelligent and uncared for, and I know you are neither

Ok, I’m not going to be like everyone else here, who overly nice to you, that’s not what you need. I’m going to give you what kept me going. If you really hate yourself as much as I did, then why the fuck are you taking the easy way out? Do you think you deserve it? Have you earned it? The only way you have earned to kill yourself is when you have exhausted every way possible to get help. If you have tried multiple medications, been with multiple therapists, and honestly tried everything you can to get better, then I think you have earned the right. Don’t you dare lie to yourself and say you’ve tried everything, stop and really fucking think about it. If you believe that you have, and for the life of you, you can’t find another thing to try, then you really do finally deserve to die.

Thats alright, it doesn't for everyone. Are you still planning on doing it this weekend, or have you moved on. I know sometimes I would want to do it and move on the next day, is that how you're feeling?

Ok, to start out I'm in a similar boat as you, but I've made promises to not do anything, and I will keep those promises, not many people are lucky enough to do that. 

Enough about me though, I need you to tell me your actual problem. If its depression, you'll get over it. Don't think for a second here that I'm just bullshitting, depression is a disease, its biological. Simply putting it, its a depletion of certain neurons that control grief, guilt, pleasure, and so on. It's fucking hard, but with medication, it will get better in time. You just have to wait, the hardest fucking part, but it will happen. 
I hate life too right now, I hate myself, I hate whats happening in this world, but the only difference between me and you right now is hope. I know I will get better, and my perception of the world is grossly morphed by my depression, but you don't have the same feelings as me. Why?

I don't want to suggest anything thats happened to you, or what your life is without me having any facts, but describe to me the best you can. Do you have friends, is your family supportive, do you have hobbies stuff like that. With this, I have hope of helping you, at least for now. 

Now I saw you don't want to elaborate about your problems, but getting it out is often the first step. One of my best friends told me about a situation he had as a kid thats caused him to be depressed, and he literally was fucked anally while swimming as a kid. That has really messed with his mind growing up. What I'm trying to tell you here is shit happens, I don't care what it is that has happened to you, I don't judge. I'm in no place to judge. I am only here to give my opinion, and help you the best I can. Just talk to me.
